purpose: Readable display names only. Source identifiers, source names, geometries and statistical joins must remain unchanged.

namingPolicy.mississauga: Remove official city-structure codes from display names and keep their full meaning as the type. Expand DT to Downtown. Where removing codes would create a duplicate, retain the full English type in parentheses on the non-neighbourhood area. No new neighbourhood names are asserted.
namingPolicy.otherCities: Title-case fully uppercase source names only. Preserve hyphens, slash-separated compound names, Bramalea letter sections, established mixed case and all original spellings. Do not add apostrophes or rename a municipal area based on a real-estate label.
